text: You, I'm recommending the "Creamy Oven-Baked Risotto" recipe. This recipe features ingredients like butter, onion, and mushrooms, but it doesn't include any of the ingredients you tend to like, such as chopped walnuts, fresh ground pepper, or white sugar [F13]. The cooking time is also shorter than what you typically prefer, taking about 40 minutes in total [F9, F5]. Nutrition-wise, this recipe is moderate in calories, high in sodium, and low in sugar [F11].
